verdict.rationale: GitCafe's repository rulesets include a documented 'Code owners' rule: each changed path needs approval from one of its owners listed in `CODEOWNERS` (docs-21). The rule sits inside branch-protecting rulesets that can require pull requests and reviews (docs-19), and an Evaluate mode lets maintainers trial it with warnings first (docs-20). missing for 10: detailed documentation of CODEOWNERS syntax and team or group ownership, independent or hands-on corroboration that enforcement works as described.
